# Overview of core business

## Seven Product Site Solutions

| Product scene | Core competencies |
| --- | --- |
| Customer relationship management | Sales, business opportunities, customers, orders, AI experts. |
| Organisation | Team communication, enterprise security. |
| Personnel management | Recruitment, remuneration, attendance, staff relations. |
| Administration | Asset management, automation of processes. |
| Procurement management | Vendor comparison, compliance audit, budget control. |
| Financial results | Real-time reporting, automated reconciliation, AI financial insight, tax compliance. |
| Meetings | A narrowband of high-resolution, AI smart conference summaries, real-time multilingual subtitles, intelligent scheduling, enterprise-level security. |

## Kuailu AI

|  |
| --- |
| Kuailu AI is an AI competency system that integrates business processes. |
| AI Area Specialists: Positions are staffed exclusively with AI Specialists, and in-depth integration of business scenarios such as CRM In-depth Analysis Specialists, Smart Passenger Services Specialists, Financial Management Specialists. |
| Kuailu Claw: 24 hours in-service digital divide, turning imagination into productivity, supporting automatic implementation, smart decision-making and cross-system synergy. |

## Product applicability and business distress

| Product or capacity | Main use of posts or departments | Main problem solving | Applicable industry or organization |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Financial results | Financial/Fund/ Audit | ERP/reimbursement/tax systems fragmented, data manually moved and cash flow forecast for distortion | Multi-organization accounting scenes such as manufacturing, retailing and enterprise groups |
| Procurement management | Procurement/ Supply Chain/ Warehousing | Price fluctuations are unpredictable, optimal options are missing, quality control is difficult to control, approvals are miscalculated Machine | Manufacturing, trade, retail chain, engineering, group gathering |
| Organisation | Overall / Cross-sectoral synergies | IM/OA/ERP Multisystem Frequent Switching, Disconnection between Communication and Implementation, and Fragmentation of AI Tool Entry | Large organizations in all sectors, especially government, finance, etc. |
| Personnel management | Human Resources | Recruitment/task/pay information island, error-prone manual accounting of remuneration, break-up of the transfer process | Multi-area/multi-job intensive manufacturing, chaining, services, groups |
| Administration | Administration / asset management | Assets, unoccupied buses, delayed compliance risk, lengthy approvals, difficult rules | Large-scale organizations such as multi-molecular corporate groups, government companies, manufacturing parks, etc. |
| Customer relationship management | Sales / Marketing / Sales Management | Logging in trouble, time-consuming, inefficient client records, fragmented client information, confused pace of follow-up, delays in contract approval, single rate of loss High | B2B Sales-driven enterprises, growing enterprises, group sales teams |
| Kuailu Meeting | Overall / Cross-sectoral synergies | Weak web-based video Cardon, high bandwidth and deployment costs, manual follow-up to meetings, hard to meet domestic compliance requirements, inefficient transnational meetings | Public services, finance, education and health |
| Kuailu Claw | IT / Operating / Business Line | Repeated cross-system operations are labour-intensive, multiple window switching is required, generic Agent lacks enterprise-level compliance controls | There are a large number of large and medium-sized organizations operating across systems across industries. |
| AI Area Specialist | Operational positions, finance/personnel/legal/client services | Professional experience is hard to settle, cross-system analysis is manual, AI is hard to embed in the existing IM, and it's a different stove. | Knowledge-intensive positions such as finance, legal affairs, manpower, customer service and medical care |
| KuWork | Personal practitioners, team leaders, business decision makers, IT and information managers | Complex tasks require a multiplicity of professional competencies, data and processes are scattered across different systems, and processes and results are difficult to integrate | Enterprises and teams with complex mandates, cross-system synergies and reuse of results |
